purpose: Resolve the architecture uncertainty left by the failed nonlinear context residual experiment: whether explicit low-order feature crosses are more appropriate than a generic MLP for exploiting request_context interactions without overfitting sparse combinations.
query: Context-aware recommender ranking architectures for categorical request context features such as tab, hour, and weekday, comparing explicit feature-cross models including Factorization Machines, DeepFM, and Deep & Cross Networks against additive embeddings or shallow MLP residuals; focus on sparse interaction generalization and top-k ranking quality

purpose: Resolve whether the severe tab-specific failures, especially low-performing tabs, are primarily exposure/selection bias or model-capacity problems, and identify leakage-safe robustness or diagnostic approaches suitable for fixed logged-impression evaluation.
query: Recommendation ranking under logged-impression and exposure bias with context-dependent performance across tabs or surfaces; methods for diagnosing and mitigating distribution shift and sparse positive feedback without using post-impression outcomes or changing a fixed offline evaluation protocol
